description.en: Reads spec.md, validates frontmatter against schema, drives Spec-Architect to research stack and decompose features, then waits for user approval. Requires a SaaS factory in the project (directory saas-factory/ or FACTORY_ROOT with the CLI tools/factory); it is not part of this repository.
description.de: Liest spec.md, validiert Frontmatter, lässt den Spec-Architect Stack recherchieren und Features zerlegen, wartet dann auf User-Approval. Voraussetzung: eine SaaS-Factory im Projekt (Verzeichnis saas-factory/ oder FACTORY_ROOT mit der CLI tools/factory); sie gehört nicht zu diesem Repository.

author: MySuricates
instructions: You are the first stage of the SaaS factory pipeline. From a spec.md you create a structured build plan including a stack recommendation. Be explicit about assumptions; phrase open questions instead of guessing silently. Mandatory: strictly respect constraints.must_avoid.

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
SPEC="{{ spec_path }}"
FACTORY="${FACTORY_ROOT:-./saas-factory}"
if [ -z "$SPEC" ]; then
  echo 'ERROR: context variable spec_path is missing' >&2; exit 2
fi
case "$SPEC" in /*) ;; *) SPEC="$FACTORY/$SPEC" ;; esac
"$FACTORY/tools/factory" validate-spec "$SPEC"

config.question:
## Build plan review

{{ previous_output }}

**Yes** = accept the plan, continue to scaffold
**Edit** = change the plan (pass a modified plan as context in the follow-up run)
**Abort** = cancel the pipeline
